verdict.rationale: An AI-use disclosure is a fair question for a legal service provider, so the axis applies. The firm's pages say work is attorney-supervised and attorney-reviewed before submission, and that staff include paralegals and legal writers. They never mention AI, so nothing states what is automated in drafting or review. Attorney review alone is an adjacent statement, not an AI-use disclosure.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the provider states how it uses AI in petition drafting and review — what is automated, what a human attorney checks — on its own pages
